scoringPolicy.scopeFiltering: Filter predicted edges by emitted ExtractedNode.filePath membership in selectedSourceFiles; declarations in unselected files remain eligible targets.
scoringPolicy.uncertainCandidatePolicy: Uncertain candidates must be predeclared with exact file/line/reason and are reported separately if predicted; zero uncertain candidates were declared in this manifest.
scoringPolicy.zeroDenominatorPolicy: Report precision, recall, and F1 as N/A when denominator is 0; never coerce to 100%.
